output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply is not checked before it is added to the balances of the holder. An attacker can mint tokens for an arbitrary user and cause an integer overflow in the totalSupply, rendering the contract unusable.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances of the sender is not checked before it is subtracted, allowing an attacker to cause an integer overflow in the balances of the sender, resulting in loss of funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances of the sender is not checked before it is subtracted, allowing an attacker to cause an integer overflow in the balances of the sender, resulting in loss of funds.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed mapping is not checked before it is set, allowing an attacker to cause an integer overflow in the allowed mapping, resulting in loss of funds.

The migrate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalMigrated is not checked before it is added, allowing an attacker to cause an integer overflow in the totalMigrated, resulting in loss of funds.
